name: Return to Vahlarriel
label: Quest
description: Dalinda Malem is ready to leave Thunder Axe Fortress. She thanks you for what you have done for her and her family, and says the time is yours to choose.…
intro: Dalinda Malem is ready to leave Thunder Axe Fortress. She thanks you for what you have done for her and her family, and says the time is yours to choose. You escort her out, then find Vahlarriel Demonslayer.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So, the time is now then? I appreciate your efforts, and if the situation does not lend itself, then allow me to thank you now for everything you've done for me and my family. If you're ready, then there is nothing else for me here--we can leave when you feel the time is right.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. Dalinda made it safely back here to Nijel's Point, and in much better condition than I could have asked for. The fact that she arrived here under her own power was a good sign. I hope you're well?

It pains me to know that both Tyranis and Dalinda didn't return, but the embarrassment of Tyranis' decisions is hers to endure. It is something she will have to deal with when she returns to Darnassus.
